# Tailwind CSS Gotchas

> Known Tailwind CSS patterns that cause silent failures or unexpected output. Load all HIGH entries before writing any Tailwind CSS.

## Entries

- [Arbitrary value syntax](arbitrary-values.md): Arbitrary values use bracket syntax: w-[42px]. No spaces inside brackets. Class names must be complete strings -- dynamic string concatenation defeats Tailwind's static analysis. HIGH.
- [Conditional classes with cn()](cn-utility.md): Use cn() (clsx + twMerge) for conditional/merged classes. Template literal concatenation silently drops conflicting utility classes without warning. HIGH.
- [Dark mode configuration](dark-mode.md): Dark mode strategy (media vs class) must be set in tailwind.config. The class strategy requires a .dark class on the html element -- it does not activate automatically. MEDIUM.
- [Tailwind 4.x @import resolves from the package directory in monorepos](v4-workspace-resolution.md): @tailwindcss/vite resolves `@import "tailwindcss"` from the file's package, not the consuming app. Add tailwindcss as a devDependency in any workspace package that imports it in CSS. HIGH.
- [Tailwind v4 silently drops utilities used only in shared monorepo packages (needs @source)](v4-source-monorepo-packages.md): v4 only auto-scans the consuming app's own root; utility classes used ONLY in a shared workspace package (e.g. packages/ui) are never compiled, so `hidden lg:flex` silently resolves to display:none. Add `@source` to the app's CSS. HIGH.
- [Tailwind v4 ignores tailwind.config.js without @config](v4-config-ignored.md): A leftover v3-style tailwind.config.js (content array, theme.extend) is completely dead under v4 unless referenced via `@config`; theme and content live in CSS (@theme / @source). MEDIUM.
- [prose classes are silently inert without the @tailwindcss/typography plugin](prose-requires-typography-plugin.md): prose/prose-sm compile to nothing when @tailwindcss/typography is not installed and registered -- the page renders browser-default unstyled with no warning; register via @plugin in CSS (v4) or use explicit utilities. HIGH.
- [sr-only on a grid/flex item silently removes the cell and shifts the whole layout](sr-only-breaks-grid-flex-layout.md): sr-only is position:absolute, so an element carrying it stops being a grid/flex item -- the container ends up one in-flow child short and every sibling after it shifts a column; nest the sr-only span inside an in-flow cell. Passes typecheck, tests, and lint. HIGH.
